biblical-theology-study.name: Biblical Theology Study
biblical-theology-study.description: A theme traced along the storyline of Scripture from promise to fulfilment.

theme.title: Theme
theme.guidance: The theme being traced and why it matters.

old-testament.title: Old Testament
old-testament.guidance: Where the theme begins and how it develops in the Law, Prophets and Writings.

gospels.title: Gospels
gospels.guidance: How the theme comes to Christ in the Gospels.

epistles.title: Epistles
epistles.guidance: How the apostles take up and apply the theme.

canonical-development.title: Canonical Development
canonical-development.guidance: How the theme grows and changes across the canon.

fulfilment.title: Fulfilment / Consummation
fulfilment.guidance: Its fulfilment in Christ and its final completion.

synthesis.title: Synthesis
synthesis.guidance: The whole-Bible picture in a few sentences.

teaching.title: Teaching
teaching.guidance: How to teach this theme faithfully and clearly.

passage-study.name: Passage Study
passage-study.description: A careful study of one passage, moving from the text itself to teaching it.

text.title: Text
text.guidance: The passage being studied, and any translation notes.

context.title: Context
context.guidance: Where the passage sits: the book, the surrounding argument, the historical setting.

observations.title: Observations
observations.guidance: What does the text say? Repeated words, connectors, contrasts, commands, questions.

structure.title: Structure
structure.guidance: How the passage is built: its movements, main clauses and turning points.

exegesis.title: Exegesis
exegesis.guidance: What did the text mean for its first readers? Key words, grammar, difficult phrases.

theology.title: Theology
theology.guidance: What the passage teaches about God, Christ, salvation and the life of faith.

application.title: Application
application.guidance: How the truth of the passage bears on belief, worship and life today.

audience.title: Audience
audience.guidance: Who will hear this teaching, what they need, and what may hinder them.

teaching.title: Teaching
teaching.guidance: Main idea, outline, illustrations and how to communicate it with love.

systematic-theology-study.name: Systematic Theology Study
systematic-theology-study.description: A doctrine studied from Scripture, the church's witness and competing positions.

doctrine.title: Doctrine
doctrine.guidance: The doctrine under study, stated plainly.

key-texts.title: Key Biblical Texts
key-texts.guidance: The passages on which the doctrine rests.

historical-theology.title: Historical Theology
historical-theology.guidance: How the church has understood the doctrine through its history.

confessional-witness.title: Confessional Witness
confessional-witness.guidance: What the creeds and confessions say.

alternative-positions.title: Alternative Positions
alternative-positions.guidance: Other views, fairly stated, with their reasons.

conclusions.title: Conclusions
conclusions.guidance: Your conclusions and how firmly you hold them.

application.title: Application
application.guidance: Why this doctrine matters for faith and life.

teaching-study.name: Teaching / Sermon Preparation
teaching-study.description: From the text to a sermon or lesson prepared for real people.

main-idea.title: Main Idea
main-idea.guidance: The one main thing the text says, in one sentence.

exegesis.title: Exegesis
exegesis.guidance: What the text meant for its first readers.

theology.title: Theology
theology.guidance: What the text teaches about God and his ways.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.guidance: What the text aims to do in its hearers.

audience.title: Audience
audience.guidance: Who will hear this, and what they need.

structure.title: Structure
structure.guidance: How the teaching will move from beginning to end.

illustrations.title: Illustrations
illustrations.guidance: Pictures and examples that serve the text.

teaching-outline.title: Teaching Outline
teaching-outline.guidance: The outline you will teach from.

topical-study.name: Topical Study
topical-study.description: A question or topic followed through the whole of Scripture.

topic.title: Question / Topic
topic.guidance: The question you are asking, stated as clearly as you can.

key-passages.title: Key Passages
key-passages.guidance: The passages that speak most directly to it.

biblical-context.title: Biblical Context
biblical-context.guidance: Where and how the topic arises across the Bible.

main-themes.title: Main Themes
main-themes.guidance: The main lines of teaching that emerge.

difficult-passages.title: Difficult Passages
difficult-passages.guidance: Texts that seem to point another way, and how to read them.

theology.title: Theology
theology.guidance: How the passages fit together into coherent teaching.

conclusions.title: Conclusions
conclusions.guidance: Your conclusions, with the passages that carry them.

application.title: Application
application.guidance: What this means for belief, worship and life.

word-study.name: Word Study
word-study.description: One word traced through Scripture, from its uses to its meaning and weight.

word.title: Word
word.guidance: The word being studied, its original form and how translations render it.

occurrences.title: Occurrences
occurrences.guidance: Where the word appears. (Automatic occurrence lists arrive with the concordance.)

immediate-contexts.title: Immediate Contexts
immediate-contexts.guidance: How each important use is shaped by its sentence and paragraph.

semantic-range.title: Semantic Range
semantic-range.guidance: The range of meanings the word carries, and what decides between them.

key-passages.title: Key Passages
key-passages.guidance: The passages where the word matters most.

theological-significance.title: Theological Significance
theological-significance.guidance: What the word contributes to the Bible's teaching.

conclusions.title: Conclusions
conclusions.guidance: What you have concluded, and what remains open.

titleRequiredOnBlur: A title is required. Leaving the field keeps the previous title.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: A project gathers related studies: a sermon series, a Bible study course, or a doctrine.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Create your first project above.

newStudy.heading: What would you like to study?
newStudy.title: Title
newStudy.subjectRequired: Type what you would like to study.

header.purposePlaceholder: What are you trying to understand or prepare?

sections.confirm: Delete “{{title}}” and the writing in it?
sections.confirmWithFindings: Delete “{{title}}” and the writing in it? Its findings stay in the study as findings for the whole study.

blocks.deleteFailed: This block could not be deleted. Please try again.

passages.label: Passages
passages.addFirst: Add the passage this study is about

templates.intro: A template gives a new study its sections. Changing a template never changes studies already made from it.
templates.confirm: Delete the template “{{name}}”? Studies already made from it are not affected.

fromSource.label: Add to Study
fromSource.title: Add to Study: {{study}}
fromSource.noStudies: There is no study yet. Start one in the Study pane, then add this to it.
fromSource.placeholder: What do you take from this?
fromSource.placeholderRequired: Write what you take from this place…

empty.title: Prepare a teaching from this study
empty.text: A sermon, a group Bible study or a lesson, written by you. You can use what you noted in this study: your notes and passages stay where they are and are simply used here. Nothing is filled in for you, and every part may stay empty.

teaching.deleteConfirm: Delete this teaching? Your study, with its notes and passages, stays as it is.
teaching.audiencePlaceholder: e.g. the whole church, a youth group
teaching.purposePlaceholder: What you hope this teaching will do
teaching.messageHint: In your own words: the one thing you most want people to take away.
teaching.notesHint: Reminders while you teach; not part of what you say.

links.findingNote: It stays in your study. If you change it there, it changes here too.

standing.verified: Sources found: two independent sites in the search results report it. Source quality varies, so read them before you use it.
standing.unverified: Needs checking: only one source was found. Read it before you use it.
standing.hypothetical: Invented example, not a real event
standing.generated: Made by the assistant: an illustration, not a photograph

action.application: Does the application follow from the passage?
action.question: Help with a discussion question…
action.restructure: How could I order what I have?

assist.title: {{action}} · {{part}}

request.question: What should the question help people notice?
request.story: What kind of real story are you looking for?
request.phrasing: What do you want to say? (optional)
request.visual: What should the picture help explain? (optional)
request.free: What would you like help with?

shared.remote: To help, this will be sent to {{assistant}}:
shared.local: This stays on this computer ({{assistant}}). It will see:
shared.teaching: the teaching’s title and kind, and its audience, purpose and central message where written
shared.nearby_one: one other part of this teaching (so it keeps your voice)
shared.nearby_other: {{count}} other parts of this teaching (so it keeps your voice)
shared.quotes_one: one quotation from a book in your library, with its source
shared.quotes_other: {{count}} quotations from books in your library, with their sources
shared.searches: Search words based on your request (they may include your words) will also go to your search service.

assist.askHint: Ctrl+Enter asks; Escape closes. Nothing is sent before you ask.
assist.failed: The assistant could not help this time.

proposal.heading: Suggested wording
proposal.notYet: Nothing has changed yet. Your text stays as it is unless you choose this.

basis.scripture: The assistant says this draws on Scripture
basis.study: The assistant says this draws on your study
basis.source: The assistant says this draws on a book in your library
basis.reasoning: The assistant’s own thought, to weigh for yourself

options.heading: Suggestions
options.invented: These are invented examples, not real events. Do not tell them as if they happened.

stories.heading: Real stories found
stories.none: No real story could be found and checked in the search results. Nothing has been made up.
stories.checkNote: Checked only against the search results’ summaries. Open the sources and read the whole story before you use it.

cannotMake.off: Making images is turned off (Settings → AI Assistant). Finding freely licensed images still works.
cannotMake.unsupported: This AI service cannot make images. You can choose OpenAI for images in Settings → AI Assistant. Finding freely licensed images still works.
cannotMake.noKey: Making images needs the OpenAI key for images (Settings → AI Assistant). Finding freely licensed images still works.

images.none: No freely licensed images were found.
images.nothingPlaced: Nothing is placed in your teaching unless you keep it.

assist.changedMeanwhile: Your text changed after you asked, so this suggestion was not used. Please ask again.
assist.freePlaceholder: e.g. Is this too long for a youth group?
assist.freeHint: The assistant sees this part and what it needs from this teaching and study. It answers with comments and questions; it does not write your teaching for you.
assist.slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can keep waiting or stop.
assist.stopped: Stopped waiting. Nothing was changed. The service may still finish the request, and it may count toward your use.

pending.story: Looking for sources… This can take a little while.
pending.makeImage: Creating an image… This can take a little while.

assist.sendsTo: Making an image sends this idea’s description to {{service}} over the internet.

questions.deleteConfirm: Delete this question and what you wrote with it? Anything from your study used here stays in the study.

steps.none: No steps yet. Add the parts of the lesson in the order they happen: a welcome, a story, an activity, a prayer…
steps.label: Step {{number}}: {{title}}
steps.explanation: What you will say or do
steps.deleteConfirm: Delete this step and what you wrote in it? Anything from your study used here stays in the study.
